title: 'My husband poisoned me but I don't fear death after what I saw in afterlife'
excerpt: Ana Christina went into temporary paralysis when she was poisoned by her husband, but what she saw during her near-death experience means she is no longer scared of dying
content:
Ana Christina went into temporary paralysis when she was poisoned by her husband, but what she saw during her near-death experience means she is no longer scared of dying

11:45, 13 Oct 2026

Near-death experiences have been recorded for more than 2,000 years. The earliest written accounts appeared in Ancient Greek texts, and some of the reports in the preceding years have been equal parts harrowing and life-affirming.

‌

‌

This includes the near-death experience of Ana Christina, whose husband reportedly tried to murder her by poisoning her dinner. But rather than ending her life, the experience resulted in Ana no longer fearing death thanks to the incredible revelations she had in the afterlife.

‌

Ana was stunned when the poison temporarily paralysed her, and she feared her life was ending. But she ended up coming back around, and it changed the course of her life.

‌

Speaking on the NDE Journey YouTube channel, she encountered dead relatives on the other side. She saw her mother, who died shortly before the incident, her dad, who died in a car crash, and her sister Nadia, who tragically killed herself.

Ana claimed that she saw her loved ones as bright bodies of light rather than in their human forms. She said: "I came to another entrance and saw a body of light. And that body of light was my mother. She was standing there waiting to greet me.

‌

"And she didn't have any facial features, she was just a body of light. But my soul recognised who she was straight away. I went to her, she had died a year before my incident."

Ana went on to say that she saw her beloved sister Nadia next, who took her own life at the age of just 35.

She added: "And I've always wondered where she (Nadia) was. Nadia had a beautiful heart but was in a deep depression where she just took her life. We have a father in heaven, who is so compassionate and doesn't judge us like we judge each other.

‌

"I raced out to the hallway where my mother was, and she was standing with another body of light, which was my father.

"My father had been killed in a car accident when I was 22 years old and I never really got over it. Seeing him there was really a beautiful closure for me. The overwhelming joy of seeing them in such a beautiful setting."

The mum said her incredible experiences of the afterlife means she is no longer scared of death. She revealed that while there are "ups and downs" in life, on the other side there is just "peace, joy and love".

‌

Seeing her loved ones gave her great comfort to know people are reunited with those they care about after they pass away.

Ana said: "I didn't feel: 'Oh, I'm dead now.' There was no end. No beginning. There was no darkness then light. I just kept on going. It was a wonderful feeling.

‌

"Some people ask me what is the most significant part of my encounter and I tell them when he told that he's in every little detail of my life, knowing that, realizing that and coming back to live life with that knowledge has been an amazing blessing.

"And that's him, the spirit of God. Think of him as a guardian angel. We are not alone and we don't die alone either."

After Ana came back around, she was stumped about what happened to her. She feared she may have suffered a heart attack or a stroke, but both her ECG and brain scan came back clear.

It was only when her lawyer suggested getting a forensic hair analysis that she got closer to the apparent truth. Lab reports seemingly showed that there she had high levels of a number of metals, including lead, mercury and selenium.

Ana said: "All these chemicals are usually found in rat poisoning. And we believe he put the rat poisoning into my rice, into the dinner, into the rice that night to finish me off so that I don't go to Egypt because he was running out of time."
